sample_unit: questions derived from AAOS CPG recommendations

links.outcome: LLM accuracy and completeness versus AAOS DDH clinical practice guideline recommendations
links.effect: Accurate in 5/9 (ChatGPT-4.0), 6/9 (ChatGPT-3.5), 6/9 (Gemini); incomplete in 7/9, 6/9, 7/9 recommendations; no significant differences between chatbots.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.0, ChatGPT-3.5, and Google Gemini were accurate in 5/9, 6/9, 6/9, supplementary in 8/9, 7/9, 9/9, and incomplete in 7/9, 6/9, 7/9 recommendations, respectively.

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses (Flesch-Kincaid, Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog)
links.effect: Chatbot responses had complex readability; Google Gemini significantly more readable than the others on all three indices (all P<0.05).
links.quote: Google Gemini was significantly more readable in Flesch-Kincaid reading level, Flesch Reading Ease, and Gunning fog index (all, P ​< ​0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, completeness, and readability of three commercial LLMs against clinical practice guidelines for pediatric hip dysplasia without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
